svg.data-weight-note: 30.8 lb (14 kg) with FRUs installed; 23.8 lb (11 kg) without (Table 5)
svg.data-depth-note: 28 in (71.1 cm) excluding FRU handles and locking levers; 29.2 in (74.2 cm) including them (Table 5)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE with SFP+ optics; 1 GbE with SFP optics in ports 6 to 41; 2, 4 or 8 Gbps Fibre Channel in ports 0 to 5 and 42 to 47
svg.data-qsfp-plus-speeds: 40 GbE; or four 10 GbE with a breakout cable (15 10 GbE interfaces by default)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 127 VAC at 7.8 A or 200 to 240 VAC at 3.8 A, 50 to 60 Hz (Table 25)
svg.data-power-input-dc: nominal -48 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 7 A maximum (Table 27)
svg.data-redundancy-note: one or two supplies; with two installed they are load-sharing and fully redundant
svg.data-fans: two fan trays of two fan modules, hot-swappable, and two fan modules on the management board; the supplies carry their own fans
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation; -5 to 55 C short term
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 3048 m (10000 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches with QFX3500, QFX3600, QFX5100 and EX4300 members; a Virtual Chassis Fabric leaf
svg.data-qfabric: a Node device, connected to a QFX3008-I or QFX3600-I Interconnect device by the uplink ports
svg.data-fcoe: an FCoE-FC gateway or FCoE transit switch
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: SFP+ transceivers, SFP+ direct attach copper cable, SFP transceivers in ports 6 to 41, Fibre Channel SFP+ in ports 0 to 5 and 42 to 47
svg.data-optics-qsfp: QSFP+ transceivers, QSFP+ DAC and DAC breakout cables
svg.data-oob: management ports C0 and C1, 1000BASE-T RJ-45 (RJ-45 board) or 1 Gbps SFP (SFP board), with link-speed and activity lamps
svg.data-lcd: an LCD showing the host name and the number of active alarms
